topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% antenna efficiency reduces effective isotropic radiated power, increasing path loss and noise temperature. This decreases signal-to-noise ratio, impacting link budget and capacity. Adaptive power allocation and modulation scheme adjustments can mitigate these effects, ensuring reliable data transmission over GEO-LEO satellite links.
reference_context: SatCom systems require careful link budget considerations, including antenna efficiency, power constraints, and noise temperatures to ensure reliable transmission.
